transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?
I guess I'm here because... I just keep blowing up at people. Over nothing, really. Snapping on operations calls at work, and... at my family. It's just not how I've ever handled things.
Have you been feeling irritable most of the time lately?
Yeah. Like I said... I guess so. It's just pretty much all the time lately. Every little thing just sets me off.
Have you always had a quick temper, or is this a recent change for you?

No. I'm usually pretty level-headed. It's... a recent thing. Just the last three weeks or so. Ever since, uh... well, we had a valve failure at the facility. There was an injury. It's just been since then.
Would you say you've always had a pretty consistent way of dealing with people and situations, even before these past three weeks?
Yeah. I mean... I was always just fine before. Handled things normally, I guess. It wasn't... like this.
Have you been feeling anxious a lot lately?
I don't know. I haven't really thought about it. I'm not sure I'd say anxious, exactly... I just haven't really noticed.
Would you say you've been acting like yourself since the valve failure incident?

I guess not. I mean... I haven't even been cleared to go back to the plant yet. And when I try to work from home, I'm... I'm missing things on calls. Upsetting people. It's gotten to the point where... I don't know, I'm worried I'm becoming a liability instead of the manager they need. So, no. Not really myself.
Have you been having any recurring thoughts or ideas that you can't seem to get out of your head lately?

Yeah. Um... I guess so. I'll just be... sitting at the kitchen table, maybe trying to answer some emails. And then... I don't know, suddenly I'm right back there. Just... seeing the flash from that valve again. The smoke in the aisle. It's like it just... shoves everything else out of my head.
Have you been avoiding people, places, or activities since the valve failure incident?
I don't really know. I mean... I guess I've just been staying home mostly. I haven't really been out much to even know if I'm avoiding anything. Just... trying to work from the house.
Have you been having trouble sleeping lately?

Yeah... I have. I just... I lie there most nights. It's like I can still hear that alarm going off in my head. And then... if I do manage to drift off, I just wake up sweating. It's... dreams, I guess. Smoke, people yelling. By the time morning comes around, it just... feels like I haven't slept at all.
Do you feel guilty about what happened during the valve failure incident?
No... not really. I mean, I didn't cause it to blow. It just... happened. So... no. I don't think so.
Do you find yourself being constantly on the lookout for potential dangers or threats?

I guess... yeah. It's mostly just... noises. Like if I hear a forklift beep, or a compressor kick on somewhere. Even just the smoke alarm chirping at the house. My whole body just... tightens up. I catch myself looking around for the exits... just trying to figure out what's gonna go wrong next.
Do you ever feel like you're outside of your body watching yourself, or like things aren't real?
No... I don't think so. I mean... I know it's all real. I don't... I've never felt like I was watching myself or anything. I'm just... here.
Do you ever feel like you're in a daze or detached from the world around you?
No... I don't think so. I mean, I'm pretty tired most days, but... I'm not in a daze or anything. I know what's going on around me. So, no.
Do you find yourself having an exaggerated startle response to sudden noises?
I don't know. I mean... like I said a minute ago, I just tense up when I hear things. I don't really know about jumping or... being exaggerated. It's just what I already told you.
Are there specific things, like places, people, or activities, that you're avoiding because they remind you of the valve failure incident?
No. I just... go to work and come home. I haven't really been avoiding anything specific. I just... keep to myself mostly.
Has your irritability or these flashbacks been causing problems for you at work or in your relationships with family and friends?

Yeah... I guess. I mean, they haven't even cleared me to go back to the plant yet anyway. So I'm just working from home. But... I don't know, I guess I'm missing things on my calls. And... I've been upsetting people. I'm just... I'm supposed to be the manager they need, but right now I'm afraid I'm just becoming a liability to them.
How long have you been experiencing these flashbacks?
About three weeks. Just... ever since the valve failed at the facility. When the injury happened. It's just been going on since then.
Are there any reminders of the valve failure incident that you're trying to avoid thinking about or looking at?
No... I don't think so. I mean, obviously I'd rather not think about it, but... there's nothing specific I'm trying not to look at. I'm just here at the house.
